T0565.title: Cookie Stuffing
T0565.definition: A fraud technique that places tracking cookies without genuine user intent to steal affiliate attribution.
T0565.description: Cookie stuffing writes tracking cookies without genuine user click or purchase intent so the attacker can claim commission on later real conversions. Defenses require validation of meaningful clicks, cookie-lifetime limits, touchpoint-quality analysis, and investigation of affiliates with unusually high conversion rates.
T0565.usageExample: Assess Cookie Stuffing related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
